Job Description:
Industrial Data Engineer
The Industrial Data Engineer will partner with the site teams to develop and execute the overall site Focused Improvement (FI) activities to improve site performance through data management. You will be responsible for all data reporting and first level analysis related to site performance KPI reporting and benchmarks. Serve as the point of contact for all data reporting systems focused on improvements and the implementation of new tools. The role is responsible for data integrity and adherence to the established ways of calculation, management through tools and reporting. This is an onsite position working from our Lewisburg, OH location.
What are we looking for?
Minimum of 3 years of Direct Manufacturing Site experience.
University degree in Industrial Engineering, Engineering or equivalent qualification.
Certified in Problem Solving Methodologies or similar, Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt or actively working towards it is a strong positive.
Preferred experience working in relationship-based team environment.
Strong data acumen, building/reviewing data basis with advanced Excel / SQL Skills.
Power BI and Power apps capabilities, building dashboards for the site.
High degree of independency and collaboration, influencing skills lateral as well as with site leadership team.
What will your key responsibilities be?
As the key user for digital solutions, you will be the sites point of contact and provides first-level support & training. This includes supporting local deployment of digital solutions and continuous improvement.
The Industrial Data Engineer is the local data steward implementing the standard data set at the site. You will be responsible for managing data quality issues as well as data cleansing and validation. Work closely with stakeholders to define and control data.
Provide daily, weekly, periodically and annual data reporting for line performance. This includes performance measuring tools (TRS/OEE) by line and equipment highlighting the different elements that builds performance reports. You will provide data around line speeds, flowrates, Non-Quality Cost (NQC) elements such as (run setup, re-use, destruction). Support the MSE Deployment plan driving data analysis.
Work directly with the site Operations team, 3 manufacturing sites, the Continuous Improvement community and MSE and Industrial Engineer leads.
As an active member of the local & regional IE/MSE team, provide functional support to the team when it is needed.
What can you expect from Mars?
Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.
